item_name: Rothco Touch Screen Neoprene Duty Gloves
item_short_desc: Stay warm and functional with Rothco Touch Screen Neoprene Duty Gloves. Designed with an ultrathin neoprene shell, these gloves provide lightweight insulation while keeping your hands protected. The synthetic leather palms offer enhanced grip and durability for everyday tasks. Featuring conductive thread on the thumb and index finger, these gloves allow seamless use of touch screen devices without removing them. The elastic cuff with a hook & loop closure ensures a secure and adjustable fit, making them ideal for long hours of wear.
